ABOUT VOODOO

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

TEAM

Our Corporate teams support the company's performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo's Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo's success.

ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Finance Data & Systems Analyst – Pigment Lead, AI & BI to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll be the internal expert and owner of our Pigment platform, while driving data, automation, and AI initiatives to elevate the Finance team's performance and service quality across FP&A and Accounting.

- Progressively take full ownership of Pigment's rollout and upkeep, reducing dependency on the external service provider and becoming the go-to internal expert on the tool

- Optimize platform configuration, drive integration development, and build a strategic roadmap to support consolidation and reporting needs across FP&A and Accounting

- Design and implement, together with the Head of FP&A, a structured budgeting process in Pigment, including workflow, calendar, and contributor governance

- Adapt and evolve Pigment use cases tied to the Accounting close process, in collaboration with the Head of Accounting

- Establish robust operational controls, including disciplined change management and a comprehensive financial data governance framework (definitions, quality, single source of truth, access governance)

- Lead data and automation projects beyond Pigment to improve Finance team performance, including self-service analytics, reconciliation automation, and variance analysis

- Drive the deployment of AI agents to replace manual processes and enhance the Finance team's operational efficiency

- Scope and contribute to building priority Finance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar), ensuring metric consistency across Pigment, BI, and Finance reporting

- Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, and user support processes to champion best practices across the Finance team

- Mentor and grow a junior analyst or intern, progressively delegating Pigment, data, or reporting responsibilities

PROFILE

- 5–8 years of experience in Finance Data, FP&A, or Finance Systems roles, ideally in consulting or a tech scale-up environment

- Hands-on experience with a Pigment rollout or run, or a similar EPM tool (Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Hyperion, etc.) - strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to internalize a tool previously managed by an external service provider, with a mandate to build internal autonomy quickly

- Comfortable working with FP&A, Accounting, and Data/IT stakeholders alike

- Some experience with SQL or Python and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)

- Genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to Finance, including no-code/low-code tools, agents, and LLMs

- Ability to structure a data governance approach at the scale of a Finance function

- Familiarity with accounting close processes is a plus

- Prior mentoring experience (junior analyst, intern, or apprentice) is a plus

- Fluent in both French and English

BENEFITS

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

- Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Remote Fridays

About the Team

DoorDash's Risk & Insurance team protects and strengthens our business by developing innovative insurance programs and operational strategies that support millions of deliveries worldwide. We partner across Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Data Science, and Operations to manage risk, improve customer outcomes, and enable the continued growth of one of the world's largest local commerce platforms.

As DoorDash continues to scale globally, Insurance Claims Operations is evolving through artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation. Our organization is reimagining how claims are managed by leveraging technology to automate routine work, enhance operational decision-making, and create scalable solutions that improve efficiency while maintaining exceptional customer experiences.

About the Role

DoorDash is seeking a Senior Claims Specialist, Insurance Claims Operations to serve as the team’s go-to expert for assessing risk and managing our highest-severity, most sensitive claims through to closure.

This role is responsible for assessing risk and severity on the most difficult cases, taking ownership of high-severity escalations, mentoring Claims Specialists, and coordinating closely with cross-functional teams across Legal, Risk & Insurance, Actuarial, and Quality Assurance. You'll utilize, help build, and scale AI-enabled tools and workflows across the team, bringing an extremely solution-oriented mindset to how the team adopts change, and contributes to training materials and process improvements based on your hands-on claims expertise.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is extremely solution-oriented and enjoys assessing risk, managing high-severity cases through to closure, sharing their expertise with others, and helping the team navigate change with a positive mindset in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

This position will report to a Supervisor, Insurance Claims Operations and is remote. Onboarding takes place Monday through Friday during the first 4–6 weeks. After onboarding, the regular work schedule may fall on Monday through Saturday between 7:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m., based on business needs.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will

• Assess risk and severity on the most complex or sensitive incidents, applying operations expertise to recommend next steps.
• Take ownership of high-severity escalations, coordinating closely with cross-functional partners - including Legal, Risk & Insurance, Actuarial, and Quality Assurance - to keep the most difficult cases moving and ensure the right people are involved at the right time.
• Serve as a go-to resource and subject matter expert for Claims Specialists.
• Spot patterns and root causes across incidents, and surface process, policy, or workflow gaps to your Supervisor and the broader Claims Operations team.
• Utilize, help build, and scale AI-enabled tools and automation, providing frontline feedback that shapes how they roll out to the wider team.
• Support quality by reviewing case work, sharing feedback, and helping close skill gaps on the team.
• Contribute to training materials, playbooks, and process documentation based on hands-on claims experience.
• Bring an extremely solution-oriented mindset to process, tool, and policy changes, helping the team navigate change with positivity.

We're excited about you because…

• 4+ years of hands-on claims operations experience (e.g., bodily injury, property, Commercial Auto, General Liability, or Workers' Compensation), including experience assessing risk and severity on high-value or sensitive claims.
• Strong risk-assessment skills - able to judge severity and exposure quickly, and know when and how to escalate.
• Experience mentoring or informally guiding less experienced Claims Specialists.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and recommend corrective action.
• Comfortable utilizing, building, and scaling AI-enabled tools and automation, and providing feedback that improves them.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including with external carrier and TPA partners.
• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
• An extremely solution-oriented mindset - leading with positivity and helping others adjust to change rather than resist it.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Job Purpose and Summary:

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day and our Pharmacy Technicians (Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise.

As a Technician, you will support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Technicians are often the first point of contact to assist our patients and customers to deliver an exceptional experience. Technicians assist the pharmacy team to ensure that pharmacy operations run smoothly, our patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately, and we are providing caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Technicians operate as part of the pharmacy team through consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered.

Once in role, Technicians are required to complete a rigorous company training program and satisfy all registration, licensing, and certification requirements according to their State’s Board of Pharmacy guidelines. Until the Pharmacy Technician has completed all necessary requirements, duties may be restricted by the Pharmacy Manager.

A Technician is responsible for contributing to safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to:

• Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists manage and improve patient health
• Following pharmacy workflow procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment

• Completing basic inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc.
• Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand clinical and technical knowledge needed to better assist patients
• Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business

• Completing additional licensure and training requirements, in compliance with state Board of Pharmacy regulations, to obtain Technician Immunizer status to support preparing and administering vaccines
• Educating patients about the importance of vaccines and referring patients to the Pharmacist-on-duty for vaccination questions
• Monitoring for, and responding to, adverse reactions; reporting adverse reaction events per public health requirements
• Reviewing and collecting patient information; tracking and documenting for each applicable patient

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have discovered what it feels like to work alongside AI that actually raises their game. Most people who could benefit from an AI collaborator haven't tried one yet, or tried once and didn't see what was possible. Closing that gap isn't a copywriting problem — it's a storytelling and enablement problem at a scale few companies have ever had to solve. That's what this role owns.

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the foundational positioning and story for Claude's core knowledge-work products — Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite. Everything that helps a knowledge worker understand what's possible, and a buyer decide with confidence, runs through your work: the website, the pitch decks, the battlecards, the persona narratives. You're not just making the case that people should adopt AI — you're equipping the people who decide to buy it and showing the people who use it, at the scale of millions, exactly how to put it to work.

This is an individual-contributor role built for someone who wants to do deep, durable craft work on products with enormous, established usage. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecards, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude and AI-native workflows to keep those foundations self-updating and trusted by every team that depends on them.

If you've owned the full product marketing stack for a large, widely-used, fast-evolving product, have building instincts for turning your own PMM workflows into systems rather than one-off documents, and want your writing to be the reason millions of people and the buyers who equip them finally understand what an AI collaborator can do, this role is for you.

Key responsibilities

•

Define the story that gets millions of people to change how they work. Own and evolve the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same compelling case for what's possible.

•

Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — that turn a good product into deals won, arming GTM to sell with confidence rather than guesswork.

•

Equip buyers to make the call with confidence. Own the proof points, comparisons, and narratives that help economic buyers and champions justify the purchase and adoption decision internally, not just the end users who'll use the product day to day.

•

Make sure the message lands with the right person, in their language. Develop ICP and persona frameworks that translate a broad, varied base of knowledge workers and buyers into insights sharp enough to drive messaging and campaigns that actually resonate.

•

Make our inspiring story come to life. Own the website and product page messaging that's often someone's very first encounter with what Claude can do for their work — the moment that decides whether they lean in or bounce.

•

Turn scattered wins into a playbook others can run. Build libraries of top use cases by product and by function or persona, so the best examples of AI-augmented work aren't one-off stories, they're patterns anyone can copy.

•

Keep every team telling the same story, well. Partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Partners so they're never working from stale or inconsistent materials.

•

"Claudify" our own foundations. Build AI-native systems, using Claude and beyond-chat workflows like Skills and automations, that keep positioning, messaging, personas, and enablement current and instantly trustworthy — proof, in how you work, of the same transformation you're asking millions of others to make.

•

Contribute to how we present plans, pricing, and analyst relations materials for the core knowledge-work portfolio as they intersect with your positioning and messaging work

Minimum qualifications

•

Have proven experience owning positioning and messaging for an established software product used broadly across personas and use cases

•

Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and complexity across formats — pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, persona docs

•

Have experience building ICP and persona frameworks and translating research into messaging that scales across websites, collateral, campaigns, and content

•

Have experience building sales enablement assets and working directly with sales teams on objection handling and win/loss dynamics

•

Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team

•

Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment

•

Are well-versed in using AI — namely Claude — to inform and automate product marketing workflows, and have built foundational systems that inform, update, and share PMM foundations with the stakeholders who depend on them

•

Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to a broad, cross-functional buyer base

Preferred qualifications

•

Experience with analyst relations processes and reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester)

•

Familiarity with plans and pricing presentation and packaging communication

•

Experience as a Senior PMM or PMM Lead at a productivity, collaboration, or knowledge-work software company with ownership of core-product positioning

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been at since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Software Engineer to design and own Coupang's Global Mobility (GM) data infrastructure from the ground up. Operating within our HR organization, the GM team supports relocating international employees through immigration, housing, onboarding, and family integration (schools, healthcare, compliance).
You will work directly alongside our Director of Product Management to architect the data backbone that powers reporting, automation, and strategic HR operations for global talent across Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and beyond. You will define the architecture and own technical execution end-to-end.
What You Will Do
Design a greenfield AWS Data Lake architecture, schema models, and data contracts with upstream HR/Talent systems while ensuring strict PIPA compliance.
Consolidate disparate source system ETL pipelines (relocation, visa, vendor, payroll) into a unified, reliable architecture.
Build multi-country logic and data routing engines for operations across Korea, Taiwan, and Japan.
Power operational BI, analytical reporting, and process automation for GM, payroll, and compliance teams.
Design data quality frameworks, validation rules, monitoring, and automated alerting for production pipelines.
Own technical execution, infrastructure provisioning, tooling selection, ADRs, and operational runbooks while PM handles stakeholder communication.
Balance short-term go-live urgency (Q3 target) with long-term architectural integrity and scalability.
Qualifications
System Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and operating complex systems end-to-end; ability to translate ambiguous business needs into concrete technical specifications for Year 1 and Year 2 scale
Backend Engineering: 3+ years of production software engineering experience (SDE background required) with deep Python or Java expertise; strong AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, Glue) and database design skills.
Data Engineering: 1+ years of ETL/ELT pipeline design and orchestration experience (Airflow, Temporal, or similar); expertise in dynamic schema design, data validation, and pipeline observability.
Collaboration: Strong partnership skills with PMs and cross-functional teams; proactive in surfacing blockers, proposing solutions, and maintaining thorough technical documentation.
Compliance & Governance: Understanding of data governance, privacy standards, and stakeholder navigation across cross-functional priorities
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience handling sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and compliance standards.
Experience with Coupang tech stack or multi-region system deployments.
Track record of taking technical projects from greenfield to production end-to-end.
Openness to tool-mediated or asynchronous non-English technical communication.

Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
Coupang does not discriminate against disabled applicants or those with veteran status. We are proud to offer equal opportunities for all applicants.
Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes.
Privacy Notice
Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice is located below.
https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/
Document Return Policy

A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.
회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
HR 조직 산하 Global Mobility (GM) 팀의 데이터 인프라스트럭처를 초기 단계부터 설계하고 전담할 소프트웨어 엔지니어를 모십니다.
GM 팀은 글로벌 인재들이 한국, 대만, 일본 등 새로운 국가와 쿠팡 환경에 연착륙할 수 있도록 이민, 비자, 주거, 자녀 교육, 의료, 정착 지원 등 온보딩 전 과정을 책임집니다. 본 포지션은 Director of PM과 2인 코어 팀을 이루어, 글로벌 임직원의 정착 지원 및 인사/급여/컴플라이언스 프로세스를 자동화하고 시각화하는 전사 데이터 인프라스트럭처의 백본(Backbone)을 아키텍처링합니다.
기술 스택 선택부터 데이터 모델링, 파이프라인 구축까지 엔지니어링 오너십을 완전히 행사하며, 대규모 시스템 구축 및 크로스 펑셔널 협업을 통해 역량을 증명하고 포트폴리오를 확장할 수 있는 기회입니다.
업무 내용
Greenfield 기반 AWS 데이터 레이크 아키텍처, 스키마, 상류 HR 시스템과의 데이터 계약(Data Contract) 설계 및 PIPA(개인정보보호법) 준수 인프라 구축.
파편화된 이주/비자, 외부 대행사, 정착 지원, 급여(Payroll) 데이터 소스를 단일 파이프라인으로 ETL 통합.
한국, 대만, 일본 등 국가별 법률 및 인사 제도를 반영한 다국적 데이터 라우팅 엔진 구축.
GM 운영, 급여, 컴플라이언스 팀을 위한 분석 리포팅(BI) 환경 구축 및 온보딩 수속 프로세스 자동화 지원.
프로덕션 데이터 파이프라인의 데이터 퀄리티 프레임워크, 유효성 검증(Validation), 모니터링 및 알림 체계 구축.
기술 스택 선정, 데이터 모델링, 인프라 프로비저닝, ADR 및 운영 런북 작성 등 기술적 실행의 완벽한 소유.

요건

백엔드 엔지니어링: 3년 이상의 프로덕션 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 경험 (SDE 백그라운드 필수), Python 또는 Java에 대한 깊은 이해, AWS(EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, Glue) 및 데이터베이스 설계 능력.
데이터 엔지니어링: 1년 이상의 ETL/ELT 파이프라인 설계/구축 경험, 데이터 오케스트레이션 툴(Airflow, Temporal 등) 활용 능력, 가변적 비즈니스 모델을 위한 스키마 설계 및 관측 가능성(Observability) 확보 경험.
협업 및 소통: PM 및 인사/비즈니스 담당자와의 원활한 소통, 이슈/블로커 선제 공유 및 해결책 제시 역량, 문서화(런북, ADR 등) 습관화.

Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

-Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential, from efficient business platforms to next-generation AI capabilities.

As a Staff Data and AI Engineer on the Enterprise Data & AI team, you will build the governed data foundations that power enterprise analytics, automation, and applied AI. Your primary focus will be data architecture and data engineering, where you will be responsible for designing and operating production data pipelines in Databricks, integrating & curating data through a medallion architecture, and defining semantic and domain models in Unity Catalog with subject-matter experts.

You will also build agents and retrieval-augmented applications directly on this governed data using Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog functions, Mosaic AI, and model serving. You will own your systems from architecture through production operations, applying strong engineering, data quality, security, evaluation, and observability practices throughout

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data and software engineer who can turn ambiguous enterprise needs into reliable data products and focused AI-enabled solutions.

The role will report to the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data and AI.

Responsibilities:

Data Pipelines and Semantic Layer (Primary)

• Build and operate pipelines that ingest source-system data into Databricks using a medallion architecture across bronze, silver, and gold layers, with lineage, provenance, access controls, and logging.
• Partner with subject-matter experts to define and evolve domain, ontology, and semantic models in Unity Catalog, then curate reliable data products into those models.
• Own data quality for the pipelines and products you build, implementing tests, monitoring, and alerting so issues surface before they reach downstream consumers.
• Integrate enterprise systems through APIs, events, and middleware while applying appropriate authentication, retries, reconciliation, and auditability.

Agents on the Databricks Data Layer (Secondary)

• Build production agents and retrieval-augmented applications grounded in governed Databricks data, using Unity Catalog functions as tools and Mosaic AI or model-serving capabilities.
• Add authorization, approvals, and auditability for consequential actions performed through agents or AI-enabled orchestrations.
• Create evaluation sets and observability for the agents you ship, including groundedness, latency, cost, and production feedback, and use the results to improve them.

Engineering Fundamentals

• Apply solid engineering practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, documentation, on-call support, and concise design notes.
• Own architecture decisions for your systems and communicate material tradeoffs clearly to technical and business partners.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software or application engineering, or an adjacent enterprise technology role.

• Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, LangChain, or CrewAI.

Company Introduction

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Role Overview

As a Senior Creator Operations Specialist for the Taiwan market, you will play a key role in growing and managing our influencer ecosystem. You will work closely with creators, agencies, and internal stakeholders to support creator acquisition, campaign execution, platform operations, and partner engagement.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on influencer marketing or creator operations experience who enjoys building relationships, managing campaigns, and driving operational excellence within a fast-growing environment.

What You Will Do

Creator Acquisition & Partner Management

• Identify, recruit, and onboard KOLs and KOCs across platforms including Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Threads.
• Build and maintain relationships with creators, MCNs, and talent agencies.
• Introduce platform opportunities and help creators understand the value of joining our ecosystem.
• Support creator growth and participation through ongoing communication and engagement.

Campaign & Platform Operations

• Manage day-to-day influencer campaign operations from onboarding through campaign completion.
• Coordinate with creators to ensure content is delivered on time and aligns with campaign requirements.
• Monitor campaign progress and proactively address operational issues.
• Act as a primary point of contact for creators, providing guidance and support throughout their platform journey.
• Track campaign performance and provide operational insights for future improvements.

Contracting & Payment Operations

• Coordinate creator and agency contracts, documentation, and onboarding requirements.
• Ensure campaign deliverables are completed and accurately tracked.
• Support monthly payment processing and creator settlement activities.
• Maintain operational records and collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely payment and compliance processes.

Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve creator experience and operational efficiency.
• Maintain accurate creator databases, tracking tools, and campaign records.
• Support the development of operational best practices and scalable workflows.

Basic Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Operations, Partnership Management, Digital Marketing, or Agency Account Management.
• Experience managing influencer campaigns and creator relationships in the Taiwan market.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and CRM or tracking tools.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with KOLs, KOCs, MCNs, talent agencies, or affiliate marketing programs.
• Familiarity with major social media platforms and creator ecosystems.
• Experience coordinating contracts, invoicing, or payment operations.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
• Interest in developing toward Partnership Management, Creator Growth, or Marketing Operations leadership roles.
